interactions.target_raw: Apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing a CARD
interactions.note: The epitope of VHH(ASC) on the caspase recruitment domain (CARD) of adaptor protein ASC was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. The monomeric mutant (N128A/E130R) of ASC(CARD) was used. These mutations were predicted to impair CARD–CARD interactions. The mutant ASC(CARD) remained monomeric, could still form a complex with VHH(ASC), and crystallized into needle-shaped crystals.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 4.21 angstroms
